crypto_headlines.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in CoinGecko
crypto_headlines.summary: Announced at Breakpoint London: the Solana Foundation acquired a majority stake in CoinGecko and plans to bring SOL-powered trading to the platform.

crypto_headlines.title: NYSE parent ICE weighs running a Solana validator
crypto_headlines.summary: Intercontinental Exchange, the parent company of the NYSE, is considering becoming a validator on Solana.

crypto_headlines.title: Wells Fargo more than doubles its IBIT stake
crypto_headlines.summary: Q3 13F filings show Wells Fargo holding 49.58M IBIT shares worth $2.35B, indirect exposure to 28,070 BTC and the largest reported IBIT position among investment managers.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC spot ETFs flip to a small inflow
crypto_headlines.summary: Per SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $7.99M on Nov 16, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $76.5M, while spot Ethereum ETFs saw $8.31M in outflows.

crypto_headlines.title: Wintermute says the bear market isn't over
crypto_headlines.summary: Wintermute's Nov 16 report says Bitcoin fell 12.7% last week to around $65,400 and that the recent selloff shows no sign of a bottom.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance attacker moves $137M in ETH
crypto_headlines.summary: Wallets linked to the Binance hack moved 74,881 ETH (about $137M) across addresses; about $1.19B in BTC and $1.16B in ETH remain unlaundered.

doginal_news.title: Doginal Dog #2674 sells for 99,000 DOGE
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dog #2674 sold for 99,000 DOGE (about $5,824), and the pack called it a grail in the replies.

doginal_news.title: Collectors chase the Turbo x3 master set
doginal_news.summary: HawaiiSol is working on a 3x master set and listed a Rise of the Pack First Edition TURBO x3 Full Art (V055) on eBay.

doginal_news.title: Pyth priced 95.9% of equity perps volume
doginal_news.summary: PIRB says Pyth priced 95.9% ($368.5B) of last month's equity perps volume.

doginal_news.title: Polymarket Perps moves ANT-USD to Pyth Pro
doginal_news.summary: Polymarket Perps switched its ANT-USD market to per-share pricing with Pyth Pro, with positions converting automatically.

doginal_news.title: Pyth putting green at Solana Breakpoint
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's booth at Breakpoint in London has a putting green: take a shot at a hole-in-one and win Pyth swag.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs or @DDLTCG in the last 24 hours, and nothing new on Toot, Atlas or Boogie cards; community items above.
